result.summary: Gates the legacy mixed-case `confTarget` option in wallet `bumpfee` and `psbtbumpfee` RPCs behind `-deprecatedrpc=confTarget`. Using the option without the deprecation flag now returns an `RPC_METHOD_DEPRECATED` error ahead of planned removal in the next cycle.
result.problem: The wallet fee-bump RPCs maintain support for an undocumented legacy `confTarget` option alongside `conf_target`, leaving lingering naming inconsistencies and duplicate parameter handling.
evidence: PR description: 'Since commit 91f6d2bc8ff4d4cd1b86daa370ec9d2d9662394d in 2020, the wallet accepts and documents conf_target for the fee bump RPC. So it seems time to cut the confusion and properly deprecate it with the next cycle.'
result.changed_since_previous: No functional changes; the concrete implementation adds the `-deprecatedrpc=confTarget` check in `bumpfee_helper`, functional test assertions, and release notes.
result.card: Gates the legacy mixed-case confTarget option in bumpfee and psbtbumpfee behind -deprecatedrpc=confTarget ahead of complete removal in the next release. The snake_case conf_target parameter has been documented and accepted since 2020, but the camelCase alias remained active. External RPC callers still using confTarget will receive a deprecation error unless the deprecation flag is set.

risk.why: RPC clients still passing the confTarget option without upgrading to conf_target or enabling the deprecation flag will have fee-bump calls fail.
